newsitem.title: FINLAND: COMMITTEE GREENLIGHTS FINNISH 1996 EXTRA BUDGET.
newsitem.headline: COMMITTEE GREENLIGHTS FINNISH 1996 EXTRA BUDGET.

text.p: Parliament's state finance committee approved the autumn 1996 supplementary budget as proposed by the government in late September, the committee said in a statement dated November 6 and received on Thursday.

According to the committee, the views of which form the base for the legislature's final decision, total expenditure in the supplementary budget would be 6.87 billion markka, bringing total 1996 state budget spending to 201.27 billion.
The government earlier said the supplementary budget would require an increase in 1996 state net borrowing of 3.6 billion markka.
Total 1996 net borrowing to cover the deficit of the state finances would be around 43 billion markka comared to about 56 billion markka in 1995, the finance ministry said in September.
In January-October, state net borrowing totalled 30.82 billion markka, according to State Treasury Office figures.
